meta.label: confirmatory STRICT, Stage 1 (AV2 sensor val, held out); three paired starts s50/s51/s52; primary = predicted sky depth by design, NOT accuracy
meta.resolution_rule: A1 bilinear pred->2048x1550 sampled at projected LiDAR px; GT never resized; sky = any-sky mask excluded
meta.disclosure: Stage 1: THREE paired 2000-step continuations (n46/s50, n47/s51, n48/s52); 3 pairs size the pair-to-pair spread only roughly; the A0/A0b screen pair showed 26% spread on a guard. P measures what the H300 hinge enforces by design (a PASS shows transfer of the hinge's effect, not accuracy; the guards carry the information). TS2+H300 was chosen after the screen on a descriptive sky secondary and was NOT BETTER on its primary (the screen primary).
